sole_predeclared_variant.definition: One exact root pass, adding at most one most-violated inbound mixed cut and one most-violated outbound mixed cut.

entry_condition: Open only if valid IR1/IR2 full closure passes the offline live gate but closure overhead clearly dominates the observed LP-bound gain.
forbidden_reasons_to_open: fit a time, Work, node, memory, size, M, Q, or named-instance threshold
add a second cut family or alter K1-AM-SF controller semantics
respond to final-MIP runtime after confirmation begins
selection_rule: IR3 must independently pass the same frozen offline live-entry gate before any live candidate test.
